name: ai-game-studio-godot
description: An opt-in, pinned Godot MCP adapter and safety workflow for Codex AI Game Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and operate one pinned Godot MCP safely.
interface.longDescription: Detects Godot projects, plans the Coding-Solo Godot MCP adapter, checks conflicts and permissions, and requires confirmation before setup or editor writes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-godot:setup-godot to inspect this Godot project and propose a pinned setup. Do not change anything yet.
